questions.rationale: Ad placement and reward disclosure need observation when ads are offered.
conditions: Apply when the reference presents advertisements or rewarded ads.
verificationPrompts: What ad choices, rewards, and disclosures are directly visible?

questions.rationale: Offer surfaces can be inspected without concluding their effect on performance or retention.
conditions: Apply when access is free and optional paid offers are visible.
verificationPrompts: Which offers, prices, and probability disclosures are directly observable?

questions.rationale: Season cadence is relevant when a season surface is observable.
conditions: Apply when a seasonal or live event structure is evidenced.
verificationPrompts: What changes at season boundaries and what remains persistent?

questions.rationale: Purchase and entitlement boundaries should be checked for a premium reference.
conditions: Apply when the reference has a paid purchase or edition structure.
verificationPrompts: What purchase, edition, or downloadable-content entitlements are observable?

questions.rationale: Access and renewal surfaces may affect the observed entitlement path.
conditions: Apply when recurring subscription access is visible.
verificationPrompts: What access, renewal, or cancellation information is directly visible?

questions.rationale: Creation and sharing need separate analysis from default game rules.
conditions: Apply when user-generated content can be created or shared.
verificationPrompts: What creation, publication, discovery, and removal paths are visible?
